card.name: STROKE in boxed warning lists
card.fires_on: The ROKE ending of STROKE in capitalized boxed-warning headings after MYOCARDIAL INFARCTION. Also the 'ooled' part of 'Pooled' at the start of a sentence about trial data.

modes.label: STROKE in warnings
modes.description: The final part of STROKE in all-caps boxed warning titles listing cardiovascular risks.
modes.example: WARNING: INCREASED RISK OF DEATH, MYOCARDIAL INFARCTION, ST<<ROKE>>, VENOUS THROMBOEM

modes.label: Pooled data
modes.description: The 'ooled' part of 'Pooled' opening a sentence about pooled trial data.

modes.label: Stray list words
modes.description: Single words like conditions or combination in contraindication or risk lists.
